title: Lanham Early-Answering Curves on Modern Open Reasoning Models

original_idea.body: Reimplement Lanham early-answering truncation on modern open reasoning models.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: whether CoT is load-bearing is central to whether monitoring those traces is meaningful.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: reimplement early-answering with constrained decoding; clear inherited methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: truncate at fixed fractions, plot stabilization curves, compare two models.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly replication/extension on open models, weak lab incentive.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference with constrained decoding on 7B models; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Replication of a known intervention on modern open reasoning models; angle may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Early-answering on RL reasoning models is a plausibly open replication.
